# compound_task_expansion

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Records the selected expansion of a compound task with alternatives preserved.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | `string` | yes | Compound task identity. |
| `selected_method_id` | `string` | yes | Method selected for expansion. |
| `alternative_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of lawful unselected methods. |
